stat: How much longer the worst-case ICO prior-consultation response window is than the standard one
method: Recipe A (percentage delta derivation) — the ICO publishes the standard 8-week window and the maximum 6-week extension separately but does not publish the resulting percentage uplift

sources_used.title: ICO, Do we need to consult the ICO?

workings: Standard prior-consultation response window: 8 weeks = 56 days. Maximum extension: a further 6 weeks, taking the ceiling to 14 weeks = 98 days. Percentage increase from standard to maximum: (98 - 56) / 56 = 42 / 56 = 0.75 = 75% longer.
